notes:
Adds an explicit force-target-rate switch for UPnP/DLNA cast upsampling: when a renderer under-declares its supported rates, the target can now be forced within the same-family integer-multiple rule, and the UI labels such a rate as forced and not backed by the device declaration.
投放升频新增「强制目标率」开关：渲染器未声明更高速率时可显式强制，仍受同族整数倍与上限约束；界面与状态会标注该速率未经设备声明验证。
